message: The other day, I found myself in a playful tug-of-war with my grandkids over our go-bags. They were convinced that packing snacks was the priority, while I was trying to sneak in some important documents and a flashlight. 😂 It reminded me that while kids think in terms of fun, we as parents and grandparents often have to balance practicality with their adventurous spirits. Finding that middle ground is a little dance of its own, but it’s all part of keeping our family ready for anything. What do you think is the most important thing to pack for your loved ones?
